title: Contains Duplicate
hint: A hash set holds each number you have already seen.

title: Valid Anagram
signature: def isAnagram(self, s: str, t: str) -> bool:
hint: Count the letters in each string. The counts match when the words are anagrams.

title: Two Sum
signature: def twoSum(self, nums: List[int], target: int) -> List[int]:
hint: A hash map stores the index of each number you have seen. Look for the target minus the current number.

title: Watch one mock interview
hint: Write what the candidate said before they started coding.

title: Valid Palindrome
hint: Move a pointer from each end. Skip anything that is not a letter or a digit. The letters you compare should match.

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
hint: Keep the lowest price so far. The profit is the current price minus that low price.

title: Binary Search
signature: def search(self, nums: List[int], target: int) -> int:
hint: Keep a left index and a right index. Compare the middle value with the target and drop the half that cannot contain it.

title: Group Anagrams
hint: Words that are anagrams look the same once their letters are sorted. Use that sorted word as the map key.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
hint: The window grows on the right. When a character repeats, move the left side until the repeat is gone.

title: Search a 2D Matrix
signature: def searchMatrix(self, matrix: List[List[int]], target: int) -> bool:
hint: The matrix is sorted as one long list. Binary search that list, then turn the index back into a row and a column.

title: 3Sum
hint: Sort the numbers. Fix one number, then move pointers from both ends to find pairs that sum to its opposite.
